warning.titlePre: Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6 Valve Seal & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: G63 AMG 6x6 models with the M157 twin-turbo V8 - fitted to every 6x6 produced - commonly show valve seal and coolant system wear. This is a well-documented pattern across the M157 engine family, confirmed in specialist circles across the wider Mercedes AMG range. We replace valve seals, coolant components and timing chain components as standard on every M157 rebuild.
